newsitem.title: USA: Ametek sees higher Q4 earnings, sales.
newsitem.headline: Ametek sees higher Q4 earnings, sales.

text.p: Ametek Inc said it expects improving performance in the fourth quarter of 1996 including increased sales and earnings compared with the same quarter of 1995.
It said this should result in double-digit growth in earnings per share and on target total year performance in 1996.
The company earlier reported higher third quarter sales and net income.
Ametek said that earnings growth in its Industrial Materials Group and Precision Instruments Group more than offset lower earnings at its Electromechanical Group.
It said it recently completed the purchase of land and buildings in the Czech Republic.

Starting in the second half of 1997, it expects this new motor operation and available infrastructure to enhance the Electromechanical Group's low-cost producer strategy and provide a platform for market expansion into the floor care and appliance markets of Eastern Europe, Ametek said.
